title: Psionic asset tested with sphere that came off a craft
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Psionic asset tested with sphere that came off a craft, about unspecified at unspecified, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I just interviewed a psionic asset yeah who has that story

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he interviewed a psionic asset, meaning a person with claimed mental or psychic abilities used by a government, known as Ry. According to Michels, Ry tells of being tested with a sphere that came off a craft. If true, it would mean people with such abilities were used to study objects from unknown craft.
